1.explanation: The reproduce code creates two mailto: links: one with only target="_blank" and one with both target="_blank" and rel="noopener". According to the bug report and images, the second link (with rel="noopener") will fail to open the email client on Chrome for Android and iOS Safari, instead opening a blank page with the mailto: URL. This demonstrates the bug scenario as described and shown in the screenshots. To reproduce, open the HTML file on a mobile browser and click both links.
1.bug_scenario: The bug scenario involves the use of rel="noopener" on <a> tags with mailto: links. When a mailto: link is opened with target="_blank" and rel="noopener" on Chrome for Android (and iOS Safari), the link fails to open the email client and instead opens a blank page with the mailto: URL in the address bar. The bug report shows that Lighthouse's audit for rel="noopener" incorrectly flags mailto: links, and following its suggestion breaks mailto: links on mobile browsers. The first image shows the audit failure, and the second image shows the broken behavior on a mobile device (blank page with mailto: URL).
